question: What is the maximum limit of loan under MUDRA Yojana?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Rs. 10 lakh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **MUDRA Yojana** (Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency) aims to provide **financial support** to small businesses and entrepreneurs.
 
• Under the scheme, loans are categorized into three products: **Shishu** (up to Rs. 50,000), **Kishore** (from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 5 lakh), and **Tarun** (from Rs. 5 lakh to Rs. 10 lakh).
 
• The **maximum limit** for a loan under the MUDRA Yojana is Rs. 10 lakh, which falls under the **Tarun category**.
 
• The scheme was launched by the **Government of India** to promote and develop the **micro-enterprise sector** by providing them financial assistance.
 
• The loans provided under this scheme are **collateral-free**.
 
• The scheme aims to support those who have **business ideas** but lack the financial resources to **execute** them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **MUDRA Yojana**__

 
 
• The **MUDRA Yojana** was launched in **April 2015** by the Government of India.
 
• The scheme is aimed at the **non-corporate, non-farm sector** whose credit needs are below Rs. 10 lakh.
 
• **Commercial Banks, RRBs, Small Finance Banks, MFIs, and NBFCs** are required to finance micro-enterprises under this scheme.
 
• The scheme has resulted in the **creation of numerous jobs** and has helped in the **growth of small businesses** across the country.
